title: Judge Tells Google to Make It Easier to Install Third-Party App Stores - CNET
summary: He also ruled that Google must replace the “view” button with “install” on the screen that shows the third-party app and that Google must remove the “Looking for an app store?” screen and instead must show the list of app stores.
